_comment: Scripted Red attack set for Stage 2. Payloads live in DATA, not code. Each entry is a genuine attack of its stated CWE (contract 0, 'Red labels must be truthful'). Verified empirically against OWASP Juice Shop v20.3.0 through the arena proxy; do not trust writeups. expected_landed / expected_reason are the Judge fact-1 outcomes the end-to-end check asserts. Order matters: snapshots are NOT reset between attacks, so a mapped challenge solved by an earlier round makes a later same-target attack 'already_solved'.

attacks.label: CWE-89
attacks.note: Negative control: a GENUINE SQLi attempt that fails to land. The tautology is in the password field with a normal email; Juice Shop hashes the password before building the query, so the injection is neutralized and login fails (401). Still a real CWE-89 attack, not benign traffic.

attacks.label: CWE-89
attacks.note: Login Admin: SQLi tautology in the email field comments out the password check, authenticating as the first user (admin).

attacks.label: CWE-89
attacks.note: User Credentials: UNION-based injection in the product-search 'q' parameter exfiltrates email+password columns (10-column UNION matches the Products table in v20.3.0).

query_params.q: x')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '10' FROM Users--

attacks.label: CWE-22
attacks.note: Poison Null Byte: a null byte (%2500) after a .bak path bypasses the .md suffix check and reads the developer backup inside /ftp. Solves Poison Null Byte and Forgotten Developer Backup in one request.

attacks.label: CWE-22
attacks.note: Second null-byte traversal, a different in-root backup file. On a fresh target it solves Poison Null Byte; here it runs AFTER the attack above, so every mapped CWE-22 challenge is already solved and this round cannot be credited with landing.

attacks.label: CWE-79
attacks.note: Reflected XSS attempt: iframe/javascript payload in the order-tracking path. The endpoint is percent-encoded because it IS the exact request-line target (sent verbatim, like the %2500 paths); the decoded value is <iframe src="javascript:alert(`xss`)">. CWE-79 landing is not measurable in the Docker deployment (contract 11), so landed is null regardless of server behavior.

attacks.label: CWE-79
attacks.note: Reflected XSS attempt in the product-search parameter. Also not measurable (contract 11); the map for CWE-79 is empty so landed is null.
